Allow.infer_sound: ∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw} {t : Allow.Ty}, Allow.inferType Γ e = some t → Allow.HasType Γ e t
Allow.typed_hole_free: ∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw} {t : Allow.Ty}, Allow.HasType Γ e t → Allow.HoleFree e
Allow.checkSlot_sound: ∀ {Γ : List Allow.Ty} {t : Allow.Ty} {e : Allow.Raw}, Allow.checkSlot Γ t e = true → Allow.HasType Γ e t
Allow.reject_preserves: ∀ (s : Allow.State) (base : Nat) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), ¬ (base = s.revision ∧ Allow.checkSlot Γ Allow.Ty.formula e = true) → Allow.commit s base Γ e = s
Allow.commit_preserves: ∀ (s : Allow.State) (base : Nat) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), s.Valid → (Allow.commit s base Γ e).Valid
Allow.commit_revision: ∀ (s : Allow.State) (Γ : List Allow.Ty) (e : Allow.Raw), Allow.checkSlot Γ Allow.Ty.formula e = true → (Allow.commit s s.revision Γ e).revision = s.revision + 1
Allow.visible_is_current: ∀ {p : Allow.Presentation} {e : Allow.Evidence}, Allow.visible p e = true → e.key = p.key ∧ e.epoch = p.epoch ∧ p.draftHash = p.key.sourceHash
Allow.canonical_eq_iff: ∀ {n : Nat} (a b : Allow.Formula n), Allow.canonical a = Allow.canonical b ↔ ∀ (v : Fin n → Bool), Allow.eval v a = Allow.eval v b
Allow.certificate_sound: ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Allow.Formula n}, Allow.Certificate a b → ∀ (v : Fin n → Bool), Allow.eval v a = Allow.eval v b
Allow.certified_merge_canonical: ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Allow.ContextualFormula n}, Allow.CertifiedMerge a b → Allow.canonicalKey a = Allow.canonicalKey b
Allow.no_unbounded_claim: ∀ (k : Allow.CommandKind) (s : Allow.SolverStatus), Allow.report k s ≠ Allow.Conclusion.unboundedValidity
Allow.unknown_is_not_unsat: ∀ (k : Allow.CommandKind) (s : Allow.SolverStatus), s = Allow.SolverStatus.UNKNOWN ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.TIMEOUT ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.CANCELLED ∨ s = Allow.SolverStatus.ERROR → ¬ Allow.Absence (Allow.report k s)
Allow.retrieval_is_authorized: ∀ {s : Allow.RetrievalScope} {rows : List Allow.Row} {r : Allow.Row}, r ∈ Allow.retrieve s rows → r.scope = s ∧ r.deleted = false ∧ r.permitted = true
Allow.pair_admission_bound: ∀ {target : Allow.TargetContext} {pool : Allow.Polarity} {run : Allow.Run} {w : Allow.Witness}, Allow.admitPair target pool run w = true → run.query.target = target ∧ run.query.polarity = pool ∧ w.ownQuery = run.query ∧ run.status = Allow.SolverStatus.SAT ∧ w.validated = true
Allow.contract_has_witness: ∃ c : Allow.KernelConfig, c = Allow.generatedKernel ∧ Allow.Coherent c
Allow.empty_domain_counterexample: ((∃ _ : Empty, True) ∨ True) ∧ ¬ (∃ _ : Empty, True ∨ True)
Allow.canonical_idempotent: ∀ {n : Nat} (t : Allow.Table n), Allow.tabulate n (Allow.lookup t) = t
Allow.distinct_inventories_distinct_keys: ∀ {n : Nat} (a b : Allow.ContextualFormula n), a.inventory ≠ b.inventory → Allow.canonicalKey a ≠ Allow.canonicalKey b
Allow.edit_hides_old: ∀ (p : Allow.Presentation) (e : Allow.Evidence) (draft : String), e.epoch = p.epoch → Allow.visible (Allow.edit p draft) e = false
Allow.admitted_pools_witness: Allow.admitPair Allow.sampleTarget .positive ⟨Allow.positiveQuery, .SAT⟩ ⟨Allow.positiveQuery, "instanceA", true⟩ = true ∧ Allow.admitPair Allow.sampleTarget .negative ⟨Allow.negativeQuery, .SAT⟩ ⟨Allow.negativeQuery, "instanceB", true⟩ = true ∧ Allow.positiveQuery ≠ Allow.negativeQuery
